instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Unit U21 (see briefs/U21.md: add the arrowhead size tests before the final `});`) failed its vitest check on every attempt, so the file is still as it was before the run: add U21's tests. The failing test, verbatim from the last attempts: "element locking > arrowhead size > undoes and redoes arrowheadSize changes and copies/pastes arrowheadSize styles between arrows" -> AssertionError: expected 1.5 to be undefined // Object.is equality, at `fireEvent.keyDown(document, { key: "z", code: "KeyZ", ctrlKey: true }); expect(getArrow(arrow.id).arrowheadSize).toBe(undefined);` (an earlier attempt: `Keyboard.undo(); expect((h.elements[0] as any).arrowheadSize).toBeUndefined();`, same error; another attempt called ElementsDelta/History internals directly and threw `TypeError: prevElements.get is not a function` at delta.ts:1696: do not call history internals, use Keyboard.undo()/Keyboard.redo() or h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionUndo/actionRedo)). delta.ts was already fixed in round 1 (applyDelta now deletes keys whose applied value is undefined, so undo can remove arrowheadSize). Likely cause in the test: the arrow is put in the scene without its own history entry (API.setElements / updateScene without CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY), so the first IMMEDIATELY commit (the preset click) records the arrow's creation and its arrowheadSize change as ONE history entry, and undo deletes the whole arrow (isDeleted: true), which keeps arrowheadSize 1.5. Make the arrow's creation its own committed history entry before changing the size (draw it with the UI tool as other history tests do, or API.updateScene({ elements, captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY })), assert `isDeleted` is false after the undo, then assert arrowheadSize undefined and `"arrowheadSize" in element` false, redo restores 1.5. Paste-styles part (AC-8): arrow to arrow only: (a) source 1.5 onto a target with none sets 1.5; (b) source with none onto a target with 1.5 clears to undefined.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
